resources.string: Sync notebooks with your Notable server, and read or download them as PDFs from any browser.
Not logged out: %1$d edits and %2$d files have not reached the server yet.
Logged out. %1$d edits and %2$d files did not reach the server. They stay on this device and are sent the next time you log in to this account.
The server no longer accepts this login. Sync stopped. Log out and log in again.
Your notebooks are kept in this device\'s own sync library. Logging in adds them to your account.
This device keeps the notebooks of %1$s on %2$s. Log in as %1$s to sync them. Other accounts can\'t log in here, so two libraries never mix.
The library on this device can\'t be opened (%1$s). Edits can\'t be saved until this is fixed.
The saved login can\'t be read (%1$s). Log in again.
Copy notebooks into the sync library

Copies every notebook, quick page and folder in this device\'s database into its sync library, and so to the server when logged in. Runs by itself on the first start and after logging in. Safe to run again: anything already copied is skipped.
%1$d notebooks the account already had got this device\'s pages and strokes.
Copying notebooks into the sync library
%1$s: %2$d pages listed in the notebook no longer exist and were left out.
Copying notebooks stopped: %1$s. It continues at the next start, or run it again in Settings → Sync.
Notebooks and strokes from the server appear here while Notable runs. Changes made here are sent too.
Up to date: %1$d documents, last change applied at %2$s.
Edits waiting to be written for sync: %1$d. Retrying every few seconds.
Saving an edit for sync: median %1$d ms, slowest %2$d ms (last %3$d edits).
Onyx froze Notable in the background, so sync only runs while Notable is open. To fix: long-press the Notable icon on the Onyx home screen and choose “Unfreeze app”.
Android stopped Notable when its package state changed, so background sync may not run.
Background activity is restricted for Notable, so sync only runs while it is open. Allow background activity in the app\'s system settings.
Battery optimization may pause sync in the background. Exempt Notable in the battery settings for reliable sync.
